summary: Verified two new features (Admin bulk PDF export + WhatsApp enquire button) on backend and frontend, plus full regression. Backend: 45/45 pytest cases pass (31 existing + 14 new PDF export tests). Frontend: PDF export dropdown, both style downloads, all three dynamic labels ('Export all products' / 'Export current filter' / 'Export N selected'), and WhatsApp button (href, target, rel, position, message contents) all verified. Regression on /api/products/{id} and admin/customer flows all pass.
verified_flows_backend: GET /api/products/export-pdf without auth -> 401 (route not shadowed by /products/{id})
GET /api/products/export-pdf?style=catalogue (admin) -> 200, application/pdf, magic bytes %PDF, Content-Disposition attachment; filename=nje-catalogue-YYYYMMDD.pdf
Filters (category_id, categories multi, min_price/max_price, search) all return valid PDFs
ids= param exports only those products (200) — invalid ids only -> 404
Zero-match search -> 404 with detail 'No products match the current filters.'
Regression: /api/products/export-pdf literal not treated as {product_id} (401 gated, not 404)
verified_flows_frontend: /admin/products: btn-export-pdf visible in toolbar next to category filter
Dropdown opens showing export-catalogue and export-pricelist items
Default label 'Export all products' when no filter/selection
'Export current filter' label when search='silver' applied
'Export 1 selected' label when a row checkbox is checked
Product detail (/product/:id): btn-whatsapp-enquire visible, green (#25D366 rgb(37,211,102))
Href = https://wa.me/919971043808?text=<encoded 'Hi NJE, I'd like to enquire about NJE-Silver-015 — nje_enamel_peacocktray_1 (₹2,000).\n\n<page-url>'>
Position: after price + description, before info grid (Category/Item Number)
Regression: admin products list renders 9 rows + New product button
Regression: customer catalogue renders 9 product cards
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in server.py (line 627 vs 666): export-pdf declared before /products/{product_id} — correct, verified via test.
PDF endpoint has hard limit of 500 products (.limit(500)) — acceptable but should be documented if catalogue grows.
AdminProducts.jsx exportPdf handler correctly URL-encodes params via URLSearchParams and streams as blob download — no issues.
WhatsApp anchor is a regular <a> with rel='noopener noreferrer' — safe against tab-nabbing.
Both new features have proper data-testid attributes making E2E testing straightforward.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded catalogue (9 products across 6 categories)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (PDF export + WhatsApp enquire) fully verified. Backend tests are consolidated in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (45 tests, run: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v). Test data-testids for new features: btn-export-pdf, export-catalogue, export-pricelist, btn-whatsapp-enquire. Login uses login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-btn (NOT login-email/login-password/login-submit).
